description: This file appears to be a documentation file (likely Markdown) describing the usage and API of Android automation features in the Playwright testing library. It includes code snippets, method descriptions, parameters, and version info, rather than actual executable source code.

classes.name: Android
classes.description: Represents the Android automation interface in Playwright, providing methods to connect, launch servers, and manage Android devices.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents an individual Android device, offering methods to interact with it such as shell commands, WebView access, and screenshots.

methods.name: Android.connect
methods.description: Attaches Playwright to an existing Android device via WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: Android.devices
methods.description: Returns a list of detected Android devices connected via ADB.

methods.name: Android.launchServer
methods.description: Launches a Playwright Android server that clients can connect to for device automation.

methods.name: Android.setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default maximum timeout for Android methods that accept a timeout parameter.
